description: This file defines the TailscaleService class which manages Tailscale integration, status checking, and related functionalities for a macOS application. It includes methods for checking installation, fetching network status, and opening related URLs.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing Tailscale VPN status, installation, and interaction within the app.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed by verifying its existence at the default installation path.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current Tailscale status through its local API.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive status check, updating internal state based on API response or fallback detection.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale application using the default file path.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app page in the Mac App Store.

methods.name: openDownloadPage
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale download page in the default browser.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale setup guide URL in the default browser.
